name: Energy Meter
author: Kevin Zakaria
description: Find out what your computer actually costs to run, without a smart plug or a house energy monitor. Live at-socket watts on the bar, and a panel with energy and cost per day, week, month and year, kept permanently from the day you install it. CPU energy comes from RAPL hardware counters and GPU power from amdgpu; the rest of the machine is a calibratable estimate, and the share of every reading that is actually measured is always on screen.

barWidget.description: Live watts on the bar; click for a 24h sparkline and energy broken down by day, week, month, and year.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar polls the backend. This does not change how often energy is sampled; that is interval_s in the backend config.

schema.label: High-draw threshold (watts)
schema.description: Bar label uses the urgent colour when live draw is at or above this.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: What the bar shows. Right-click the widget to cycle. watts = live draw, todayKwh = today's energy, monthKwh = month to date.
